name: Londonderry Day Camp (Camp Pa-Gon-Ki)
operator_name: The Granite YMCA (YMCA of Greater Londonderry)
description_short: A traditional outdoor day camp run by the YMCA of Greater Londonderry for children entering grades 1-9, with weekly themes, camp songs and add-on specialty camps. Camp runs 8:30 am to 4:00 pm with free before and after care, and teens entering grades 8-11 can join Leader in Training and Counselor in Training programs.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming is listed as an afternoon activity. The Londonderry Y campus, which hosts day camp, has an outdoor pool. Swim tests and supervision are not described.

refund_policy_summary: A $35 nonrefundable deposit is due per camper per week. Cancel more than 6 weeks before a camp week for a full refund less the deposit; 3 to 6 weeks before, a $65 admin fee also applies; under 3 weeks, no refund. Balances are drafted about 6 weeks before each week.
